rules.description: Default SPY. Fit XLE log returns on SPY and availability-stamped Brent with nonnegative slopes and free intercept on prior252 before last20. At z<=-2 command 100% XLE at next NAV; freeze fit, exit z>=0 or after20 holding intervals.

Default SHY. Fit IEF log returns on SHY/TLT using prior252 before last20. At z<=-2 buy IEF; at z>=2 buy funded SHY/TLT proportional to positive-sum nonnegative slopes. Freeze fit/weights, exit zero crossing or20 holding intervals.

source_files_copied: Code only; no raw market histories or arrays copied or read

math.training_return_positions: i-271 through i-20 inclusive (252); first possible i=272 after273levels
math.fit: Centered two-feature active-subset nonnegative least squares with free intercept; full centered rank2 required. Subsets (), (0), (1), (0,1); reject slopes<-1e-12; cliptinyneg to0; SSE tie tolerance32*eps*max(1,SSE,bestSSE), earlier subset retained.
math.sigma: Sample residualSD ddof1 on training; finite>0 required
math.z: sum20 residual logs / (entry_training_sigma*sqrt20); not a cointegration or Gaussian claim
math.entry_fit: Freeze beta/intercept/sigma/fit start/end/entry dislocation and normalized barbell weights through exit
math.age: At signal position i, age=i-(entry_signal_position+1). At age>=19 signal exit for i+1, giving20held close-to-close intervals
math.exit_priority: max_hold first, then invalid_active_features, then zero_crossing
math.holdings: Barbell weights drift between actual target-change events; no daily reset

clock.signals: Current-session logtotalNAV and already available Brent at decision; latest target shiftedonce by originalbuild_packet
clock.execution: Next observed NAV reference. Old ownedunits earn intervalinto thatreference; newunits earn followinginterval. No exchange fill claim.
clock.brent: Latest observation_date+8calendar days <= NAVsession date; exact matches allowed; preserve original convention. Actual historical publication/vintage unproven.
clock.future: Require actualNAV availability by archiveddecision and previousdecision strictlybefore nextreferenceclose. ActualBrent publication ANDfirstseen must beknown by firstsession where +8 permits use. Unqualified clocks stop; do not silently retime to newrule.
clock.app_pending: Atdecision store plannedcalendar session and awaiting-next-reference status. Next actualobserveddate/availabletime in complete replay is separate AFTER_DECISION_AUDIT_ONLY; never markas known earlier.

funding.units: Funded fractional current-share-equivalent totalNAV reference units; not nominalETFshares
funding.gross: Charge buys+sells independently at5/10/20bp; initial entry and one terminal liquidation; nofee netting
funding.cash: Actual residualfundedcash, zeroyield; SHY retains supplied totalNAVreturn
funding.expenses: Fundexpense/financing/distributions alreadyin totalNAV; no recharging. Synthetic reinvestment is not actualpayment-datecash.
funding.initial: On declared evaluationstart initialize latest alreadylagged target even without event; startcapital100000
funding.terminal: Declared evaluationend only; skipordinaryeventtrade andliquidate once. Originalterminalsaved exposure precedes liquidation; appownedunits arezeroafter.
funding.other: No tax, minimumcommission, sharegrid, extra funding, order, account or broker adapter

prospective.rule_freeze: This contract/code freeze precedes any new supplied prospective outcome
prospective.warmup: Atleast273 priorlevels + availableBrent; warmupdata exposed/informationonly, no futureoutcomeclaim
prospective.observations: Archive each NAV observationID, availableat, decisiontime, plannedcalendar session, Brentobservation/publication/firstseen and sourcehash. No collector orpaperorder activation.
prospective.review: At63sessions review availability/implementation/errors only. At252 reportall30cases, standalone benchmark/stability/fees/exposure and actualentry/exit counts; independentaudit before changedrecommendation.
prospective.selection: No automaticranking/pass, retuning, weightselection or postfinalnomination. Preserve oldfailures. Returnandexceptionalstability both matter; strongreturns/highvol alone are not vetoes.
prospective.limit: Future NAVreference evaluation is not proof of exchange execution oractualcashactions; portfolio contribution remains separately measured diagnostic.

failure_policy.input_failure: Stopconsumedrun oninvalidschema, clocks, sourcehash, ordereddate/fivefundNAV, missingpublication orfunding; writeFIRST_STOP and retainnoautomaticretry
failure_policy.active_failure: Exactoriginal invalidactive20featurewindow ->nextNAVbaselineexit; sourcevalidation maystop earlierwhen executionmarks unusable
failure_policy.uncertainty: Unverifiedhistorical availability/actions do not veto disclosedreleasedNAVreference replay; prospective actualclocks mustbequalified
